# Trace formats

Every display format a trace can use (DISPLAY → FORMAT), from `trace_info_list` in
`plot.c`. "Scale" is the default value per grid division; "S11 / S21" says which
channel's FORMAT menu offers it. Console name: the lower-case form used by `trace N {format}`.

| Format | Console | S11 | S21 | Unit | Scale/div | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LOGMAG | `logmag` | ✓ | ✓ | dB | 10 dB | Magnitude in dB: 20·log₁₀\|S\|. Return loss for S11 (more negative = better match), insertion loss/gain for S21. |
| PHASE | `phase` | ✓ | ✓ | ° | 90 ° | Phase of S11 or S21 in degrees, −180…+180 (wraps). |
| DELAY | `delay` | ✓ | ✓ | s | 1 ns | Group delay: −dφ/dω, the rate of phase change with frequency, in seconds. Sensitive to noise on S11. |
| SMITH | `smith` | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | Smith chart of S11 (or S21): the complex reflection coefficient on the impedance grid; marker readout selectable (R+jX, R+L/C, admittance, …). |
| POLAR | `polar` | ✓ | ✓ | — | — | Polar plot of the complex S-parameter: magnitude as radius, phase as angle, with no impedance grid. |
| LINEAR | `linear` | ✓ | ✓ | — | 0.125 | Linear magnitude \|S\| (0…1 for a passive S11). |
| SWR | `swr` | ✓ |  | — | 0.25 | Standing-wave ratio from \|S11\|: (1+\|Γ\|)/(1−\|Γ\|). 1.0 is a perfect match; the grid's bottom line is 1.0. |
| REAL | `real` | ✓ | ✓ | — | 0.25 | Real part of the S-parameter (Re Γ). |
| IMAG | `imag` | ✓ | ✓ | — | 0.25 | Imaginary part of the S-parameter (Im Γ). |
| R | `r` | ✓ |  | Ω | 100 Ω | Series resistance R of the impedance Z = R + jX seen at the port, in ohms. |
| X | `x` | ✓ |  | Ω | 100 Ω | Series reactance X of Z = R + jX, in ohms; negative = capacitive, positive = inductive, zero at resonance. |
| \|Z\| | `z` | ✓ |  | Ω | 50 Ω | Impedance magnitude \|Z\| in ohms. |
| Z phase | `zp` | ✓ |  | ° | 90 ° | Impedance phase angle: atan2(X, R) in degrees. |
| G | `g` | ✓ |  | S | 0.01 S | Conductance G of the admittance Y = G + jB, in siemens. |
| B | `b` | ✓ |  | S | 0.01 S | Susceptance B of Y = G + jB, in siemens. |
| \|Y\| | `y` | ✓ |  | S | 0.02 S | Admittance magnitude \|Y\| in siemens. |
| Rp | `rp` | ✓ |  | Ω | 100 Ω | Parallel-equivalent resistance Rp (the impedance modelled as Rp in parallel with a reactance), in ohms. |
| Xp | `xp` | ✓ |  | Ω | 100 Ω | Parallel-equivalent reactance Xp, in ohms. |
| Cs | `cs` | ✓ |  | F | 10 nF | Series-equivalent capacitance derived from X (valid where X is capacitive), in farads. |
| Ls | `ls` | ✓ |  | H | 10 nH | Series-equivalent inductance derived from X (valid where X is inductive), in henries. |
| Cp | `cp` | ✓ |  | F | 10 nF | Parallel-equivalent capacitance derived from B, in farads. |
| Lp | `lp` | ✓ |  | H | 10 nH | Parallel-equivalent inductance derived from B, in henries. |
| Q | `q` | ✓ |  | — | 10 | Quality factor of the series impedance, \|X\| / R. |
| Rser | `rser` |  | ✓ | Ω | 100 Ω | Resistance of a device measured in series between the ports (S21 series-through method), in ohms. |
| Xser | `xser` |  | ✓ | Ω | 100 Ω | Reactance of a series-through device, in ohms. |
| \|Zser\| | `zser` |  | ✓ | Ω | 100 Ω | Impedance magnitude of a series-through device, in ohms. |
| Rsh | `rsh` |  | ✓ | Ω | 100 Ω | Resistance of a device measured as a shunt across the through path (S21 shunt method), in ohms. |
| Xsh | `xsh` |  | ✓ | Ω | 100 Ω | Reactance of a shunt device, in ohms. |
| \|Zsh\| | `zsh` |  | ✓ | Ω | 100 Ω | Impedance magnitude of a shunt device, in ohms. |
| Q | `q21` |  | ✓ | — | 10 | Quality factor from the S21 series/shunt measurement, \|X\| / R. |
| SWR ANT | `swrant` | ✓ |  | — | 0.25 | SWR at the far end of the feedline: \|S11\| corrected for the one-way cable loss entered under CABLE LOSS (or computed from CABLE TYPE and CABLE LENGTH on the H4). Blank until a loss is set; see the README's SWR ANT section. |
